page.content:
Taste of place: altitude, variety, process, and soil in the cup.

How Coffee terroir connects

  • Topic: Third wave coffee — Third wave talks about coffee as terroir, like wine.
  • Location: Yirgacheffe — Yirgacheffe is a type specimen of coffee sold as taste of place.
  • Topic: Coffee roasting — Roast level is how terroir is kept or cooked out of the bean.

What is Coffee terroir?

Coffee terroir is the wine idea applied to beans. Third-wave menus list Yirgacheffe or a Yemeni lot the way a list lists a village, not a blend number.

Key threads lead to Third wave coffee, Yirgacheffe and Coffee roasting.
